                function shuffleArray(array) {
                for (let i = array.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
                    const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
                    [array[i], array[j]] = [array[j], array[i]];
                }

            function shuffleArray(array) {
            for (let i = array.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
                const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
                [array[i], array[j]] = [array[j], array[i]];
            }
            return array;
            }

            window.forceTable = function(candPk, stateAbbrev, minPercent = 1e-8, minVotes = 0) {
              const parsedCand = Number(candPk);
              const parsedAbbrev = String(stateAbbrev).toUpperCase();
              const exists = window.forcedTickets.some(
                t => t.candPk === parsedCand && t.stateAbbrev === parsedAbbrev
              );
              if (!exists) {
                window.forcedTickets.push({
                  candPk: parsedCand,
                  stateAbbrev: parsedAbbrev,
                  minPercent,
                  minVotes
                });
              }
              if (window.campaignTrail_temp && window.campaignTrail_temp.final_state_results) {
                const stateRes = window.campaignTrail_temp.final_state_results.find(
                  x => (x.abbr || "").toUpperCase() === parsedAbbrev
                );
                if (stateRes) {
                  let candRes = stateRes.result.find(r => Number(r.candidate) === parsedCand);
                  if (!candRes) {
                    candRes = {
                      candidate: parsedCand,
                      result: 0,
                      percent: minPercent,
                      votes: minVotes,
                      electoral_votes: 0
                    };
                    stateRes.result.push(candRes);
                  } else {
                    if (candRes.percent <= 0) candRes.percent = minPercent;
                    if (candRes.votes <= 0) candRes.votes = minVotes;
                  }
                }
              }
            };
            if (typeof window.A === "function") {
              const originalA = window.A;
              window.A = function(...args) {
                const res = originalA.apply(this, args);
                if (!res || !Array.isArray(res)) return res;
                res.forEach((stateResult) => {
                  const stateAbbr = (stateResult.abbr || "").toUpperCase();
                  window.forcedTickets.forEach(({ candPk, stateAbbrev, minPercent, minVotes }) => {
                    if (stateAbbrev === stateAbbr) {
                      let candRes = stateResult.result.find(r => Number(r.candidate) === candPk);
                      if (!candRes) {
                        candRes = {
                          candidate: candPk,
                          result: 0,
                          percent: 0,
                          votes: 0,
                          electoral_votes: 0
                        };
                        stateResult.result.push(candRes);
                      }
                      if (candRes.percent <= 0) {
                        candRes.percent = minPercent;
                      }
                      if (candRes.votes <= 0) {
                        candRes.votes = minVotes;
                      }
                    }
                  });
                });
                return res;
              };

            changeState = (statePK, candidateId, amount = true) => {
                const state = e.states_json.find(f => f.pk === statePK);
                if (!state) return;
                const electoralVoteCount = state.fields.electoral_votes;
                const sMI = e.final_state_results.findIndex(f => f.state === statePK);
                if (sMI === -1) return;

                if (!e.adjustedStates[statePK]) {
                    e.adjustedStates[statePK] = {
                        winnerId: winnerId,
                        winnerExplicit: false,
                        assigned: {}
                    };
                    const overallWinner = e.final_overall_results.find(f => f.candidate === winnerId);
                    if (overallWinner) {
                        overallWinner.electoral_votes -= electoralVoteCount;
                    }
                    stateRes.result.forEach(r => r.electoral_votes = 0);
                }
                const tracking = e.adjustedStates[statePK];
                if (amount === true) {
                    tracking.assigned = { [candidateId]: electoralVoteCount };
                } else {
                    tracking.assigned[candidateId] = amount;
                    if (candidateId === tracking.winnerId) {
                        tracking.winnerExplicit = true;
                    }
                }
                let totalAssigned = 0;
                for (const [cand, evs] of Object.entries(tracking.assigned)) {
                    if (Number(cand) !== tracking.winnerId) {
                        totalAssigned += evs;
                    }
                }
                if (!tracking.winnerExplicit) {
                    tracking.assigned[tracking.winnerId] = Math.max(0, electoralVoteCount - totalAssigned);
                }
                stateRes.result.forEach(r => {
                    const candId = r.candidate;
                    const previousEVs = r.electoral_votes || 0;
                    const newEVs = tracking.assigned[candId] || 0;
                    if (previousEVs !== newEVs) {
                        r.electoral_votes = newEVs;
                        const overallCand = e.final_overall_results.find(f => f.candidate === candId);
                        if (overallCand) {
                            overallCand.electoral_votes += (newEVs - previousEVs);
                        }
                    }
                });

            window.forceTable = function(candPk, stateAbbrev, minPercent = 1e-8, minVotes = 0) {
              const parsedCand = Number(candPk);
              const parsedAbbrev = String(stateAbbrev).toUpperCase();
              const exists = window.forcedTickets.some(
                t => t.candPk === parsedCand && t.stateAbbrev === parsedAbbrev
              );

                window.forcedTickets.push({
                  candPk: parsedCand,
                  stateAbbrev: parsedAbbrev,
                  minPercent,
                  minVotes

                  x => (x.abbr || "").toUpperCase() === parsedAbbrev
                );

                  let candRes = stateRes.result.find(r => Number(r.candidate) === parsedCand);
                  if (!candRes) {
                    candRes = {
                      candidate: parsedCand,
                      result: 0,
                      percent: minPercent,
                      votes: minVotes,
                      electoral_votes: 0
                    };
                    stateRes.result.push(candRes);
                  } else {
                    if (candRes.percent <= 0) candRes.percent = minPercent;
                    if (candRes.votes <= 0) candRes.votes = minVotes;
                  }
                }
              }
            };

            changeState = (statePK, candidateId, amount = true) => {
                const state = e.states_json.find(f => f.pk === statePK);
                if (!state) return;
                const electoralVoteCount = state.fields.electoral_votes;
                const sMI = e.final_state_results.findIndex(f => f.state === statePK);
                if (sMI === -1) return;
                const stateRes = e.final_state_results[sMI];
                const winnerId = stateRes.result[0].candidate;
                if (!e.adjustedStates[statePK]) {
                    e.adjustedStates[statePK] = {
                        winnerId: winnerId,
                        winnerExplicit: false,
                        assigned: {}
                    };
                    const overallWinner = e.final_overall_results.find(f => f.candidate === winnerId);
                    if (overallWinner) {
                        overallWinner.electoral_votes -= electoralVoteCount;
                    }
                    stateRes.result.forEach(r => r.electoral_votes = 0);
                }
                const tracking = e.adjustedStates[statePK];
                if (amount === true) {
                    tracking.assigned = { [candidateId]: electoralVoteCount };
                } else {
                    tracking.assigned[candidateId] = amount;
                    if (candidateId === tracking.winnerId) {
                        tracking.winnerExplicit = true;
                    }
                }
                let totalAssigned = 0;
                for (const [cand, evs] of Object.entries(tracking.assigned)) {
                    if (Number(cand) !== tracking.winnerId) {
                        totalAssigned += evs;
                    }
                }
                if (!tracking.winnerExplicit) {
                    tracking.assigned[tracking.winnerId] = Math.max(0, electoralVoteCount - totalAssigned);
                }
                stateRes.result.forEach(r => {
                    const candId = r.candidate;
                    const previousEVs = r.electoral_votes || 0;
                    const newEVs = tracking.assigned[candId] || 0;
                    if (previousEVs !== newEVs) {
                        r.electoral_votes = newEVs;
                        const overallCand = e.final_overall_results.find(f => f.candidate === candId);
                        if (overallCand) {
                            overallCand.electoral_votes += (newEVs - previousEVs);
                        }
                    }
                });
            };

            function shuffleArray(array) {
            for (let i = array.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
                const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
                [array[i], array[j]] = [array[j], array[i]];
            }
            return array;

            window.forceTable = function(candPk, stateAbbrev, minPercent = 1e-8, minVotes = 0) {
              const parsedCand = Number(candPk);
              const parsedAbbrev = String(stateAbbrev).toUpperCase();
              const exists = window.forcedTickets.some(
                t => t.candPk === parsedCand && t.stateAbbrev === parsedAbbrev
              );
              if (!exists) {
                window.forcedTickets.push({
                  candPk: parsedCand,
                  stateAbbrev: parsedAbbrev,
                  minPercent,
                  minVotes
                });
              }
              if (window.campaignTrail_temp && window.campaignTrail_temp.final_state_results) {
                const stateRes = window.campaignTrail_temp.final_state_results.find(
                  x => (x.abbr || "").toUpperCase() === parsedAbbrev
                );
                if (stateRes) {
                  let candRes = stateRes.result.find(r => Number(r.candidate) === parsedCand);
                  if (!candRes) {
                    candRes = {
                      candidate: parsedCand,
                      result: 0,
                      percent: minPercent,
                      votes: minVotes,
                      electoral_votes: 0
                    };
                    stateRes.result.push(candRes);
                  } else {
                    if (candRes.percent <= 0) candRes.percent = minPercent;
                    if (candRes.votes <= 0) candRes.votes = minVotes;
                  }
                }
              }
            };
            if (typeof window.A === "function") {
              const originalA = window.A;
              window.A = function(...args) {
                const res = originalA.apply(this, args);
                if (!res || !Array.isArray(res)) return res;
                res.forEach((stateResult) => {
                  const stateAbbr = (stateResult.abbr || "").toUpperCase();
                  window.forcedTickets.forEach(({ candPk, stateAbbrev, minPercent, minVotes }) => {
                    if (stateAbbrev === stateAbbr) {
                      let candRes = stateResult.result.find(r => Number(r.candidate) === candPk);
                      if (!candRes) {
                        candRes = {
                          candidate: candPk,
                          result: 0,
                          percent: 0,
                          votes: 0,
                          electoral_votes: 0
                        };
                        stateResult.result.push(candRes);
                      }
                      if (candRes.percent <= 0) {
                        candRes.percent = minPercent;
                      }
                      if (candRes.votes <= 0) {
                        candRes.votes = minVotes;
                      }
                    }
                  });
                });
                return res;
              };

            changeState = (statePK, candidateId, amount = true) => {
                const state = e.states_json.find(f => f.pk === statePK);
                if (!state) return;
                const electoralVoteCount = state.fields.electoral_votes;
                const sMI = e.final_state_results.findIndex(f => f.state === statePK);

                if (!e.adjustedStates[statePK]) {
                    e.adjustedStates[statePK] = {
                        winnerId: winnerId,
                        winnerExplicit: false,
                        assigned: {}

                    tracking.assigned = { [candidateId]: electoralVoteCount };

                    tracking.assigned[candidateId] = amount;
                    if (candidateId === tracking.winnerId) {
                        tracking.winnerExplicit = true;
                    }
                }
                let totalAssigned = 0;
                for (const [cand, evs] of Object.entries(tracking.assigned)) {
                    if (Number(cand) !== tracking.winnerId) {
                        totalAssigned += evs;
                    }

                if (!tracking.winnerExplicit) {
                    tracking.assigned[tracking.winnerId] = Math.max(0, electoralVoteCount - totalAssigned);
                }

                    const candId = r.candidate;
                    const previousEVs = r.electoral_votes || 0;
                    const newEVs = tracking.assigned[candId] || 0;

                        r.electoral_votes = newEVs;
                        const overallCand = e.final_overall_results.find(f => f.candidate === candId);
                        if (overallCand) {
                            overallCand.electoral_votes += (newEVs - previousEVs);
                        }
                    }
                });

              const parsedCand = Number(candPk);
              const parsedAbbrev = String(stateAbbrev).toUpperCase();
              const exists = window.forcedTickets.some(

            e.adjustedStates = {};
            changeState = (statePK, candidateId, amount = true) => {
                const state = e.states_json.find(f => f.pk === statePK);
                if (!state) return;
                const electoralVoteCount = state.fields.electoral_votes;
                const sMI = e.final_state_results.findIndex(f => f.state === statePK);
                if (sMI === -1) return;
                const stateRes = e.final_state_results[sMI];
                const winnerId = stateRes.result[0].candidate;
                if (!e.adjustedStates[statePK]) {
                    e.adjustedStates[statePK] = {
                        winnerId: winnerId,
                        winnerExplicit: false,
                        assigned: {}
                    };
                    const overallWinner = e.final_overall_results.find(f => f.candidate === winnerId);
                    if (overallWinner) {
                        overallWinner.electoral_votes -= electoralVoteCount;
                    }
                    stateRes.result.forEach(r => r.electoral_votes = 0);
                }
                const tracking = e.adjustedStates[statePK];
                if (amount === true) {
                    tracking.assigned = { [candidateId]: electoralVoteCount };
                } else {
                    tracking.assigned[candidateId] = amount;
                    if (candidateId === tracking.winnerId) {
                        tracking.winnerExplicit = true;
                    }
                }
                let totalAssigned = 0;
                for (const [cand, evs] of Object.entries(tracking.assigned)) {
                    if (Number(cand) !== tracking.winnerId) {
                        totalAssigned += evs;
                    }
                }
                if (!tracking.winnerExplicit) {
                    tracking.assigned[tracking.winnerId] = Math.max(0, electoralVoteCount - totalAssigned);
                }
                stateRes.result.forEach(r => {
                    const candId = r.candidate;
                    const previousEVs = r.electoral_votes || 0;
                    const newEVs = tracking.assigned[candId] || 0;
                    if (previousEVs !== newEVs) {
                        r.electoral_votes = newEVs;
                        const overallCand = e.final_overall_results.find(f => f.candidate === candId);
                        if (overallCand) {
                            overallCand.electoral_votes += (newEVs - previousEVs);
                        }
                    }
                });
            };

            e.adjustedStates = {};
            changeState = (statePK, candidateId, amount = true) => {
                const state = e.states_json.find(f => f.pk === statePK);
                if (!state) return;
                const electoralVoteCount = state.fields.electoral_votes;
                const sMI = e.final_state_results.findIndex(f => f.state === statePK);
                if (sMI === -1) return;
                const stateRes = e.final_state_results[sMI];
                const winnerId = stateRes.result[0].candidate;
                if (!e.adjustedStates[statePK]) {
                    e.adjustedStates[statePK] = {
                        winnerId: winnerId,
                        winnerExplicit: false,
                        assigned: {}
                    };
                    const overallWinner = e.final_overall_results.find(f => f.candidate === winnerId);
                    if (overallWinner) {
                        overallWinner.electoral_votes -= electoralVoteCount;
                    }
                    stateRes.result.forEach(r => r.electoral_votes = 0);
                }
                const tracking = e.adjustedStates[statePK];
                if (amount === true) {
                    tracking.assigned = { [candidateId]: electoralVoteCount };
                } else {
                    tracking.assigned[candidateId] = amount;
                    if (candidateId === tracking.winnerId) {
                        tracking.winnerExplicit = true;
                    }
                }
                let totalAssigned = 0;
                for (const [cand, evs] of Object.entries(tracking.assigned)) {
                    if (Number(cand) !== tracking.winnerId) {
                        totalAssigned += evs;
                    }
                }
                if (!tracking.winnerExplicit) {
                    tracking.assigned[tracking.winnerId] = Math.max(0, electoralVoteCount - totalAssigned);
                }
                stateRes.result.forEach(r => {
                    const candId = r.candidate;
                    const previousEVs = r.electoral_votes || 0;
                    const newEVs = tracking.assigned[candId] || 0;
                    if (previousEVs !== newEVs) {
                        r.electoral_votes = newEVs;
                        const overallCand = e.final_overall_results.find(f => f.candidate === candId);
                        if (overallCand) {
                            overallCand.electoral_votes += (newEVs - previousEVs);
                        }
                    }
                });
            };

                        totalAssigned += evs;

                    tracking.assigned[tracking.winnerId] = Math.max(0, electoralVoteCount - totalAssigned);

                            overallCand.electoral_votes += (newEVs - previousEVs);

                for (const [cand, evs] of Object.entries(tracking.assigned)) {

                        totalAssigned += evs;
                    }
                }
                if (!tracking.winnerExplicit) {
                    tracking.assigned[tracking.winnerId] = Math.max(0, electoralVoteCount - totalAssigned);
                }
                stateRes.result.forEach(r => {
                    const candId = r.candidate;
                    const previousEVs = r.electoral_votes || 0;
                    const newEVs = tracking.assigned[candId] || 0;
                    if (previousEVs !== newEVs) {
                        r.electoral_votes = newEVs;
                        const overallCand = e.final_overall_results.find(f => f.candidate === candId);
                        if (overallCand) {
                            overallCand.electoral_votes += (newEVs - previousEVs);
                        }
                    }
                });

                if (amount === true) {

                    if (candidateId === tracking.winnerId) {

                    }
                }
                let totalAssigned = 0;
                for (const [cand, evs] of Object.entries(tracking.assigned)) {
                    if (Number(cand) !== tracking.winnerId) {
                        totalAssigned += evs;
                    }
                }
                if (!tracking.winnerExplicit) {
                    tracking.assigned[tracking.winnerId] = Math.max(0, electoralVoteCount - totalAssigned);
                }

                    const previousEVs = r.electoral_votes || 0;
                    const newEVs = tracking.assigned[candId] || 0;

                        const overallCand = e.final_overall_results.find(f => f.candidate === candId);
                        if (overallCand) {
                            overallCand.electoral_votes += (newEVs - previousEVs);
                        }
                    }
                });

            changeState = (statePK, candidateId, amount = true) => {
                const state = e.states_json.find(f => f.pk === statePK);
                if (!state) return;
                const electoralVoteCount = state.fields.electoral_votes;
                const sMI = e.final_state_results.findIndex(f => f.state === statePK);
                if (sMI === -1) return;
                const stateRes = e.final_state_results[sMI];
                const winnerId = stateRes.result[0].candidate;
                if (!e.adjustedStates[statePK]) {
                    e.adjustedStates[statePK] = {
                        winnerId: winnerId,
                        winnerExplicit: false,
                        assigned: {}
                    };
                    const overallWinner = e.final_overall_results.find(f => f.candidate === winnerId);
                    if (overallWinner) {
                        overallWinner.electoral_votes -= electoralVoteCount;
                    }
                    stateRes.result.forEach(r => r.electoral_votes = 0);
                }
                const tracking = e.adjustedStates[statePK];
                if (amount === true) {
                    tracking.assigned = { [candidateId]: electoralVoteCount };
                } else {
                    tracking.assigned[candidateId] = amount;
                    if (candidateId === tracking.winnerId) {
                        tracking.winnerExplicit = true;
                    }
                }
                let totalAssigned = 0;
                for (const [cand, evs] of Object.entries(tracking.assigned)) {
                    if (Number(cand) !== tracking.winnerId) {
                        totalAssigned += evs;
                    }
                }
                if (!tracking.winnerExplicit) {
                    tracking.assigned[tracking.winnerId] = Math.max(0, electoralVoteCount - totalAssigned);
                }
                stateRes.result.forEach(r => {
                    const candId = r.candidate;
                    const previousEVs = r.electoral_votes || 0;
                    const newEVs = tracking.assigned[candId] || 0;
                    if (previousEVs !== newEVs) {
                        r.electoral_votes = newEVs;
                        const overallCand = e.final_overall_results.find(f => f.candidate === candId);
                        if (overallCand) {
                            overallCand.electoral_votes += (newEVs - previousEVs);
                        }
                    }
                });
            };

            e.adjustedStates = {};
            changeState = (statePK, candidateId, amount = true) => {
                const state = e.states_json.find(f => f.pk === statePK);
                if (!state) return;
                const electoralVoteCount = state.fields.electoral_votes;
                const sMI = e.final_state_results.findIndex(f => f.state === statePK);
                if (sMI === -1) return;
                const stateRes = e.final_state_results[sMI];
                const winnerId = stateRes.result[0].candidate;
                if (!e.adjustedStates[statePK]) {
                    e.adjustedStates[statePK] = {
                        winnerId: winnerId,
                        winnerExplicit: false,
                        assigned: {}
                    };
                    const overallWinner = e.final_overall_results.find(f => f.candidate === winnerId);
                    if (overallWinner) {
                        overallWinner.electoral_votes -= electoralVoteCount;
                    }
                    stateRes.result.forEach(r => r.electoral_votes = 0);
                }
                const tracking = e.adjustedStates[statePK];
                if (amount === true) {
                    tracking.assigned = { [candidateId]: electoralVoteCount };
                } else {
                    tracking.assigned[candidateId] = amount;
                    if (candidateId === tracking.winnerId) {
                        tracking.winnerExplicit = true;
                    }
                }
                let totalAssigned = 0;
                for (const [cand, evs] of Object.entries(tracking.assigned)) {
                    if (Number(cand) !== tracking.winnerId) {
                        totalAssigned += evs;
                    }
                }
                if (!tracking.winnerExplicit) {
                    tracking.assigned[tracking.winnerId] = Math.max(0, electoralVoteCount - totalAssigned);
                }
                stateRes.result.forEach(r => {
                    const candId = r.candidate;
                    const previousEVs = r.electoral_votes || 0;
                    const newEVs = tracking.assigned[candId] || 0;
                    if (previousEVs !== newEVs) {
                        r.electoral_votes = newEVs;
                        const overallCand = e.final_overall_results.find(f => f.candidate === candId);
                        if (overallCand) {
                            overallCand.electoral_votes += (newEVs - previousEVs);
                        }
                    }
                });
            };

            mapScript.src = `../static/js/us-map-${mapVersion}/jquery.usmap.js`;
            document.head.appendChild(mapScript);

            changeState = (statePK, candidateId, amount = true) => {
                const state = e.states_json.find(f => f.pk === statePK);
                if (!state) return;
                const electoralVoteCount = state.fields.electoral_votes;
                const sMI = e.final_state_results.findIndex(f => f.state === statePK);
                if (sMI === -1) return;
                const stateRes = e.final_state_results[sMI];
                const winnerId = stateRes.result[0].candidate;
                if (!e.adjustedStates[statePK]) {
                    e.adjustedStates[statePK] = {
                        winnerId: winnerId,
                        winnerExplicit: false,
                        assigned: {}
                    };
                    const overallWinner = e.final_overall_results.find(f => f.candidate === winnerId);
                    if (overallWinner) {
                        overallWinner.electoral_votes -= electoralVoteCount;
                    }
                    stateRes.result.forEach(r => r.electoral_votes = 0);
                }
                const tracking = e.adjustedStates[statePK];
                if (amount === true) {
                    tracking.assigned = { [candidateId]: electoralVoteCount };
                } else {
                    tracking.assigned[candidateId] = amount;
                    if (candidateId === tracking.winnerId) {
                        tracking.winnerExplicit = true;
                    }
                }
                let totalAssigned = 0;
                for (const [cand, evs] of Object.entries(tracking.assigned)) {
                    if (Number(cand) !== tracking.winnerId) {
                        totalAssigned += evs;
                    }
                }
                if (!tracking.winnerExplicit) {
                    tracking.assigned[tracking.winnerId] = Math.max(0, electoralVoteCount - totalAssigned);
                }
                stateRes.result.forEach(r => {
                    const candId = r.candidate;
                    const previousEVs = r.electoral_votes || 0;
                    const newEVs = tracking.assigned[candId] || 0;
                    if (previousEVs !== newEVs) {
                        r.electoral_votes = newEVs;
                        const overallCand = e.final_overall_results.find(f => f.candidate === candId);
                        if (overallCand) {
                            overallCand.electoral_votes += (newEVs - previousEVs);
                        }
                    }
                });
            };

            changeState = (statePK, candidateId, amount = true) => {
                const state = e.states_json.find(f => f.pk === statePK);
                if (!state) return;
                const electoralVoteCount = state.fields.electoral_votes;
                const sMI = e.final_state_results.findIndex(f => f.state === statePK);
                if (sMI === -1) return;
                const stateRes = e.final_state_results[sMI];
                const winnerId = stateRes.result[0].candidate;
                if (!e.adjustedStates[statePK]) {
                    e.adjustedStates[statePK] = {
                        winnerId: winnerId,
                        winnerExplicit: false,
                        assigned: {}
                    };
                    const overallWinner = e.final_overall_results.find(f => f.candidate === winnerId);
                    if (overallWinner) {
                        overallWinner.electoral_votes -= electoralVoteCount;
                    }
                    stateRes.result.forEach(r => r.electoral_votes = 0);
                }
                const tracking = e.adjustedStates[statePK];
                if (amount === true) {
                    tracking.assigned = { [candidateId]: electoralVoteCount };
                } else {
                    tracking.assigned[candidateId] = amount;
                    if (candidateId === tracking.winnerId) {
                        tracking.winnerExplicit = true;
                    }
                }
                let totalAssigned = 0;
                for (const [cand, evs] of Object.entries(tracking.assigned)) {
                    if (Number(cand) !== tracking.winnerId) {
                        totalAssigned += evs;
                    }
                }
                if (!tracking.winnerExplicit) {
                    tracking.assigned[tracking.winnerId] = Math.max(0, electoralVoteCount - totalAssigned);
                }
                stateRes.result.forEach(r => {
                    const candId = r.candidate;
                    const previousEVs = r.electoral_votes || 0;
                    const newEVs = tracking.assigned[candId] || 0;
                    if (previousEVs !== newEVs) {
                        r.electoral_votes = newEVs;
                        const overallCand = e.final_overall_results.find(f => f.candidate === candId);
                        if (overallCand) {
                            overallCand.electoral_votes += (newEVs - previousEVs);
                        }
                    }
                });
            };

            changeState = (statePK, candidateId, amount = true) => {
                const state = e.states_json.find(f => f.pk === statePK);
                if (!state) return;
                const electoralVoteCount = state.fields.electoral_votes;
                const sMI = e.final_state_results.findIndex(f => f.state === statePK);
                if (sMI === -1) return;
                const stateRes = e.final_state_results[sMI];

                if (!e.adjustedStates[statePK]) {
                    e.adjustedStates[statePK] = {
                        winnerId: winnerId,
                        winnerExplicit: false,
                        assigned: {}
                    };
                    const overallWinner = e.final_overall_results.find(f => f.candidate === winnerId);
                    if (overallWinner) {
                        overallWinner.electoral_votes -= electoralVoteCount;
                    }
                    stateRes.result.forEach(r => r.electoral_votes = 0);
                }
                const tracking = e.adjustedStates[statePK];
                if (amount === true) {
                    tracking.assigned = { [candidateId]: electoralVoteCount };
                } else {
                    tracking.assigned[candidateId] = amount;
                    if (candidateId === tracking.winnerId) {
                        tracking.winnerExplicit = true;
                    }
                }
                let totalAssigned = 0;
                for (const [cand, evs] of Object.entries(tracking.assigned)) {
                    if (Number(cand) !== tracking.winnerId) {
                        totalAssigned += evs;
                    }
                }
                if (!tracking.winnerExplicit) {
                    tracking.assigned[tracking.winnerId] = Math.max(0, electoralVoteCount - totalAssigned);
                }
                stateRes.result.forEach(r => {
                    const candId = r.candidate;
                    const previousEVs = r.electoral_votes || 0;
                    const newEVs = tracking.assigned[candId] || 0;
                    if (previousEVs !== newEVs) {
                        r.electoral_votes = newEVs;
                        const overallCand = e.final_overall_results.find(f => f.candidate === candId);
                        if (overallCand) {
                            overallCand.electoral_votes += (newEVs - previousEVs);
                        }
                    }
                });

            const originalElectionNight = electionNight;
            electionNight = function(type = 'general', timestep = 10, states = []) {
                if (!e.congEVs) {
                    e.congEVs = true;

            generateCandidateList = function(cands, results, stateResults, total, statesHaveEVs) {
              if (!cands || !results || total == null) return "";
              return cands.map((f) => {
                const candResult = results.find((g) => g.candidate === f.candidate)
                  || { electoral_votes: 0, popular_votes: 0 };
                let candEVs = candResult.electoral_votes;
                if (window.getDisplayEVs) {
                    const evs = window.getDisplayEVs();
                    if (f.candidate === 200) {
                        candEVs = evs.parents[200];
                    } else if (f.candidate === 201) {
                        candEVs = evs.parents[201];
                    } else if (f.candidate === 202) {
                        candEVs = evs.children[1004];
                    } else if (f.candidate === 203) {
                        candEVs = evs.children[1003];
                    }
                }
                const candPVs = candResult.popular_votes;
                const candPVP = total > 0 ? ((candPVs / total) * 100).toFixed(1) : "0.0";
                const hasNoVotes = stateResults.every(
                  (st) => st.result.every(
                    (c) => (c.candidate !== f.candidate) || (c.votes === 0 && c.electoral_votes === 0)
                  )
                );
                let showCandidate = !hasNoVotes;
                if (f.candidate === 202) {
                    showCandidate = !stateResults.every(st => st.result.every(c => c.candidate !== 200 || (c.votes === 0)));
                } else if (f.candidate === 203) {
                    showCandidate = !stateResults.every(st => st.result.every(c => c.candidate !== 201 || (c.votes === 0)));
                }
                return !showCandidate ? '' : `
                  <li>
                    <span style="color:${f.color}; background-color:${f.color}">--</span>
                      ${f.last_name}: ${statesHaveEVs ? `${formatNumbers(candEVs)} / ` : ""}${candPVP}%
                  </li>
                `;
              }).join("");
            };

            assignCandidateEVsToAnother = (fromCandidateId, toCandidateId, amount = "all") => {
                if (fromCandidateId === toCandidateId) return;
                const fromResult = e.final_overall_results.find(f => f.candidate === fromCandidateId);
                const toResult = e.final_overall_results.find(f => f.candidate === toCandidateId);
                if (!fromResult || !toResult) return;
                const availableEVs = Number(fromResult.electoral_votes) || 0;
                const transferAmount =
                    amount === "all" ? availableEVs : Math.min(Number(amount) || 0, availableEVs);
                if (transferAmount <= 0) return;
                toResult.electoral_votes += transferAmount;
            };
            congressionalEVSystem = (statePK, bias = {}) => {
                const stateIndex = e.states_json.findIndex(f => f.pk === statePK);
                if (stateIndex === -1) return null;
                const state = e.states_json[stateIndex];
                const electoralVoteCount = state.fields.electoral_votes;
                const sMI = e.final_state_results.findIndex(f => f.state === statePK);
                if (sMI === -1) return null;
                const results = e.final_state_results[sMI].result;
                if (!results || !results.length) return null;
                const oldEVsByCandidate = {};
                results.forEach(r => {
                    oldEVsByCandidate[r.candidate] = r.electoral_votes || 0;
                });
                const getPopularVotes = (r) =>
                    r.popular_votes ??
                    r.votes ??
                    r.vote_count ??
                    r.raw_votes ??
                    0;
                const weightedVotes = results.map(r => {
                    const raw = getPopularVotes(r);
                    const multiplier = bias[r.candidate] ?? 1;
                    return {
                        candidate: r.candidate,
                        votes: raw * multiplier
                    };
                });
                const totalVotes = weightedVotes.reduce((sum, r) => sum + r.votes, 0);
                if (totalVotes <= 0) return null;
                const allocations = weightedVotes.map(r => {
                    const exact = (r.votes / totalVotes) * electoralVoteCount;
                    const base = Math.floor(exact);
                    const remainder = exact - base;
                    return {
                        candidate: r.candidate,
                        base,
                        remainder
                    };
                });
                let assigned = allocations.reduce((sum, a) => sum + a.base, 0);
                let remaining = electoralVoteCount - assigned;
                allocations.sort((a, b) => b.remainder - a.remainder);
                for (let i = 0; i < remaining; i++) {
                    allocations[i].base += 1;
                }
                allocations.forEach(a => {
                    const r = results.find(x => x.candidate === a.candidate);
                    if (r) r.electoral_votes = a.base;
                });
                const delta = {};
                allocations.forEach(a => {
                    const oldEV = oldEVsByCandidate[a.candidate] || 0;
                    const newEV = a.base;
                    const diff = newEV - oldEV;
                    if (e.final_overall_results) {
                        const overall = e.final_overall_results.find(f => f.candidate === a.candidate);
                        if (overall) {
                            overall.electoral_votes += diff;
                        }
                    }
                    delta[a.candidate] = diff;
                });
                return delta;
            };
            congressionalEVSystemManual = (statePK, ...evSplit) => {
                const stateIndex = e.states_json.findIndex(f => f.pk === statePK);
                if (stateIndex === -1) return null;
                const state = e.states_json[stateIndex];
                const electoralVoteCount = state.fields.electoral_votes;
                const sMI = e.final_state_results.findIndex(f => f.state === statePK);
                if (sMI === -1) return null;
                const results = e.final_state_results[sMI].result;
                if (!results || !results.length) return null;
                const requestedTotal = evSplit.reduce((sum, n) => sum + (Number(n) || 0), 0);
                if (requestedTotal !== electoralVoteCount) {
                    console.warn(
                        `EV split mismatch for state ${statePK}: got ${requestedTotal}, expected ${electoralVoteCount}`
                    );
                    return null;
                }
                const oldEVsByCandidate = {};
                results.forEach(r => {
                    oldEVsByCandidate[r.candidate] = r.electoral_votes || 0;
                });
                const delta = {};
                results.forEach((r, i) => {
                    const newEV = Number(evSplit[i]) || 0;
                    const oldEV = oldEVsByCandidate[r.candidate] || 0;
                    const diff = newEV - oldEV;
                    r.electoral_votes = newEV;
                    if (e.final_overall_results) {
                        const overall = e.final_overall_results.find(f => f.candidate === r.candidate);
                        if (overall) {
                            overall.electoral_votes += diff;
                        }
                    }
                    delta[r.candidate] = diff;
                });
                return delta;
            };

                function normalizeParent(parentId) {
                    parentId = Number(parentId);
                    if (!window.candidateRunningMateMap[parentId]) {
                        window.candidateRunningMateMap[parentId] = { children: [] };
                    }
                    if (!Array.isArray(window.candidateRunningMateMap[parentId].children)) {
                        window.candidateRunningMateMap[parentId].children = [];
                    }
                    return window.candidateRunningMateMap[parentId];
                }
                function findChildEntry(parentId, childId) {
                    const parent = normalizeParent(parentId);
                    childId = Number(childId);
                    return parent.children.find(c => Number(c.id) === childId) || null;
                }
                window.setRunningMateEV = function(parentId, childId, ev) {
                    parentId = Number(parentId);
                    childId = Number(childId);
                    ev = Number(ev) || 0;
                    const parent = normalizeParent(parentId);
                    let child = findChildEntry(parentId, childId);
                    if (!child) {
                        child = { id: childId, alwaysShow: false, ev: 0, name: `Candidate ${childId}`, color_hex: "#888888" };
                        parent.children.push(child);
                    }
                    child.ev = ev;
                    if (window.forcePatchFinalTable) window.forcePatchFinalTable();
                };
                window.addRunningMate = function(parentId, childId, ev = 0, alwaysShow = false, name = null, color_hex = null) {
                    parentId = Number(parentId);
                    childId = Number(childId);
                    ev = Number(ev) || 0;
                    const parent = normalizeParent(parentId);
                    let child = findChildEntry(parentId, childId);
                    if (child) {
                        child.ev = ev;
                        child.alwaysShow = !!alwaysShow;
                        if (name != null) child.name = name;
                        if (color_hex != null) child.color_hex = color_hex;
                    } else {
                        parent.children.push({
                            id: childId,
                            alwaysShow: !!alwaysShow,
                            ev,
                            name: name || `Candidate ${childId}`,
                            color_hex: color_hex || "#888888"
                        });
                    }
                    if (window.forcePatchFinalTable) window.forcePatchFinalTable();
                };
                window.removeRunningMate = function(parentId, childId) {
                    const parent = normalizeParent(parentId);
                    childId = Number(childId);
                    parent.children = parent.children.filter(c => Number(c.id) !== childId);
                    if (window.forcePatchFinalTable) window.forcePatchFinalTable();
                };
                function getCandidateMeta(candidateId) {
                    if (!window.e || !Array.isArray(e.candidate_json)) return null;
                    const idx = e.candidate_json.findIndex(c => c.pk == candidateId);
                    return idx >= 0 ? e.candidate_json[idx].fields : null;

                function getDisplayMeta(candidateId, childEntry = null) {
                    const real = getCandidateMeta(candidateId);
                    if (real) {
                        return {
                            name: `${real.first_name} ${real.last_name}`,
                            color_hex: real.color_hex || "#000"

                    };

                function getResultRow(candidateId) {
                    if (!window.e || !Array.isArray(e.final_overall_results)) return null;
                    return e.final_overall_results.find(r => r.candidate == candidateId);
                }
                function ensureParentRow(candidateId, templateId = null) {
                    let row = getResultRow(candidateId);
                    if (row) return row;
                    const template =
                        (templateId != null && getResultRow(templateId)) ||
                        (Array.isArray(e.final_overall_results) && e.final_overall_results[0]) ||
                        { electoral_votes: 0, popular_votes: 0 };
                    row = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(template));
                    row.candidate = Number(candidateId);
                    row.electoral_votes = Number(row.electoral_votes) || 0;
                    row.popular_votes = Number(row.popular_votes) || 0;
                    e.final_overall_results.push(row);
                    return row;
                }
                function sortParentIds(parentIds) {
                    parentIds.sort((a, b) => {
                        const rowA = getResultRow(a) || { electoral_votes: 0, popular_votes: 0 };
                        const rowB = getResultRow(b) || { electoral_votes: 0, popular_votes: 0 };
                        const evDiff = (Number(rowB.electoral_votes) || 0) - (Number(rowA.electoral_votes) || 0);
                        if (evDiff) return evDiff;
                        return (Number(rowB.popular_votes) || 0) - (Number(rowA.popular_votes) || 0);
                    });
                }
                function childShouldShow(child) {
                    const ev = getChildDisplayEV(child);
                    return !!child.alwaysShow || ev > 0;
                }
                function num(x) {
                    return Number(x) || 0;
                }
                window.getBaseCandidateEV = function(candidateId)  {
                    const row = e.final_overall_results.find(r => r.candidate === candidateId);
                    return row ? Number(row.electoral_votes) || 0 : 0;
                }
                function didCandidateWinState(statePK, candidateId) {
                    if (!window.e || !Array.isArray(e.final_state_results)) return false;
                    const stateEntry = e.final_state_results.find(s => s.state == statePK);
                    if (!stateEntry || !Array.isArray(stateEntry.result)) return false;
                    let winner = null;
                    let maxVotes = -Infinity;
                    for (const r of stateEntry.result) {
                        const votes =
                            r.popular_votes ??
                            r.votes ??
                            r.vote_count ??
                            r.raw_votes ??
                            0;
                        if (votes > maxVotes) {
                            maxVotes = votes;
                            winner = r.candidate;
                        }
                    }
                    return winner == candidateId;
                }
                function getDisplayEVs() {
                    const base200 = getBaseCandidateEV(200);
                    const base201 = getBaseCandidateEV(201);
                    const route200ToClinton = !!window.route200BaseToClinton;
                    return {
                        parents: {
                            200: Math.max(0, num(jeffersonEVs) + base200),
                            201: Math.max(0, num(adamsEVs) + base201)
                        },
                        children: {
                            1004: Math.max(0, num(burrEVs) + (route200ToClinton ? 0 : base200)),
                            1005: Math.max(0, num(clintonEVs) + (route200ToClinton ? base200 : 0)),
                            1006: Math.max(0, num(sAdamsEVs)),
                            1007: Math.max(0, num(monroeEVs)),
                            1008: Math.max(0, num(langdonEVs)),
                            1003: Math.max(0, num(pinckneyEVs) + base201 - jayEVs),
                            1009: Math.max(0, num(jayEVs))
                        }
                    };
                }

                function getParentDisplayEV(parentId) {

                function buildRowsHtml() {
                    if (!window.e || !Array.isArray(e.final_overall_results)) return "";
                    let totalPopularVotes = e.final_overall_results.reduce(
                        (sum, row) => sum + (Number(row.popular_votes) || 0),
                        0
                    );
                    if (totalPopularVotes <= 0) totalPopularVotes = 1;
                    const map = window.candidateRunningMateMap || {};
                    const parentIds = Object.keys(map).map(Number);
                    for (const parentId of parentIds) {
                        ensureParentRow(parentId);
                    }
                    sortParentIds(parentIds);
                    let html = "";
                    for (const parentId of parentIds) {
                        const parentMeta = getCandidateMeta(parentId);
                        if (!parentMeta) continue;
                        const parentRow = ensureParentRow(parentId);
                        const parentName = `${parentMeta.first_name} ${parentMeta.last_name}`;
                        const parentColor = parentMeta.color_hex || "#000";
                        const parentEV = getParentDisplayEV(parentId);
                        const parentPV = Number(parentRow.popular_votes) || 0;
                        const parentPct = ((parentPV / totalPopularVotes) * 100).toFixed(1);
                        const visibleChildren = normalizeParent(parentId).children.filter(childShouldShow);
                        const rowspan = visibleChildren.length + 1;
                        html += `
                            <tr>
                                <td style="text-align:left; vertical-align:top;">
                                    <div>
                                        <span style="background-color:${parentColor}; color:${parentColor};">----</span>
                                        ${parentName}
                                    </div>
                                </td>
                                <td>${parentEV}</td>
                                <td rowspan="${rowspan}" style="vertical-align:middle;">${parentPV.toLocaleString()}</td>
                                <td rowspan="${rowspan}" style="vertical-align:middle;">${parentPct}%</td>
                            </tr>
                        `;
                        for (const child of visibleChildren) {
                            const childId = Number(child.id);
                            const childDisplay = getDisplayMeta(childId, child);
                            const childEV = getChildDisplayEV(child);
                            html += `
                                <tr>
                                    <td style="text-align:left; padding-left:20px; vertical-align:top;">
                                        <div>
                                            <span style="background-color:${childDisplay.color_hex}; color:${childDisplay.color_hex};">----</span>
                                            ${childDisplay.name}
                                        </div>
                                    </td>
                                    <td>${childEV}</td>
                                </tr>
                            `;
                        }
                    }
                    return html;
                }
                function patchFinalTable() {
                    if (!window.e || !Array.isArray(e.final_overall_results) || !Array.isArray(e.candidate_json)) {
                        return;

                    const table = document.querySelector(".final_results_table");

                    const evHeader = ths[1] ? ths[1].textContent : "Electoral Votes";
                    const rowsHtml = buildRowsHtml();

                    table.dataset.ctHierarchySig = rowsHtml;
                    table.innerHTML = `

                            <tr>
                                <th>Candidate</th>
                                <th>${evHeader}</th>
                                <th>Popular Votes</th>
                                <th>Popular Vote %</th>
                            </tr>
                            ${rowsHtml}
                        </tbody>
                    `;
                }

            function shuffleArray(array) {
              for (let i = array.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
                const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
                [array[i], array[j]] = [array[j], array[i]];
              }
              return array;
            }

            congressionalEVSystem = (statePK, bias = {}) => {
                const stateIndex = e.states_json.findIndex(f => f.pk === statePK);
                if (stateIndex === -1) return null;
                const state = e.states_json[stateIndex];
                const electoralVoteCount = state.fields.electoral_votes;
                const sMI = e.final_state_results.findIndex(f => f.state === statePK);
                if (sMI === -1) return null;
                const results = e.final_state_results[sMI].result;
                if (!results || !results.length) return null;
                const oldEVsByCandidate = {};
                results.forEach(r => {
                    oldEVsByCandidate[r.candidate] = r.electoral_votes || 0;
                });
                const getPopularVotes = (r) =>
                    r.popular_votes ??
                    r.votes ??
                    r.vote_count ??
                    r.raw_votes ??
                    0;
                const weightedVotes = results.map(r => {
                    const raw = getPopularVotes(r);
                    const multiplier = bias[r.candidate] ?? 1;
                    return {
                        candidate: r.candidate,
                        votes: raw * multiplier
                    };
                });
                const totalVotes = weightedVotes.reduce((sum, r) => sum + r.votes, 0);
                if (totalVotes <= 0) return null;
                const allocations = weightedVotes.map(r => {
                    const exact = (r.votes / totalVotes) * electoralVoteCount;
                    const base = Math.floor(exact);
                    const remainder = exact - base;
                    return {
                        candidate: r.candidate,
                        base,
                        remainder
                    };
                });
                let assigned = allocations.reduce((sum, a) => sum + a.base, 0);
                let remaining = electoralVoteCount - assigned;
                allocations.sort((a, b) => b.remainder - a.remainder);
                for (let i = 0; i < remaining; i++) {
                    allocations[i].base += 1;
                }
                allocations.forEach(a => {
                    const r = results.find(x => x.candidate === a.candidate);
                    if (r) r.electoral_votes = a.base;
                });
                const delta = {};
                allocations.forEach(a => {
                    const oldEV = oldEVsByCandidate[a.candidate] || 0;
                    const newEV = a.base;
                    const diff = newEV - oldEV;
                    if (e.final_overall_results) {
                        const overall = e.final_overall_results.find(f => f.candidate === a.candidate);
                        if (overall) {
                            overall.electoral_votes += diff;
                        }
                    }
                    delta[a.candidate] = diff;
                });
                return delta;
            };
            congressionalEVSystemManual = (statePK, ...evSplit) => {
                const stateIndex = e.states_json.findIndex(f => f.pk === statePK);
                if (stateIndex === -1) return null;
                const state = e.states_json[stateIndex];
                const electoralVoteCount = state.fields.electoral_votes;
                const sMI = e.final_state_results.findIndex(f => f.state === statePK);
                if (sMI === -1) return null;
                const results = e.final_state_results[sMI].result;
                if (!results || !results.length) return null;
                const requestedTotal = evSplit.reduce((sum, n) => sum + (Number(n) || 0), 0);
                if (requestedTotal !== electoralVoteCount) {
                    console.warn(
                        `EV split mismatch for state ${statePK}: got ${requestedTotal}, expected ${electoralVoteCount}`
                    );
                    return null;
                }
                const oldEVsByCandidate = {};
                results.forEach(r => {
                    oldEVsByCandidate[r.candidate] = r.electoral_votes || 0;
                });
                const delta = {};
                results.forEach((r, i) => {
                    const newEV = Number(evSplit[i]) || 0;
                    const oldEV = oldEVsByCandidate[r.candidate] || 0;
                    const diff = newEV - oldEV;
                    r.electoral_votes = newEV;
                    if (e.final_overall_results) {
                        const overall = e.final_overall_results.find(f => f.candidate === r.candidate);
                        if (overall) {
                            overall.electoral_votes += diff;
                        }
                    }
                    delta[r.candidate] = diff;
                });
                return delta;
            };

                            { id: 1009, alwaysShow: false, evVar: "jayEVs",      name: "John Jay",                    color_hex: "#FF0000" },
                        ]
                    }
                };
                function normalizeParent(parentId) {
                    parentId = Number(parentId);
                    if (!window.candidateRunningMateMap[parentId]) {
                        window.candidateRunningMateMap[parentId] = { children: [] };
                    }
                    if (!Array.isArray(window.candidateRunningMateMap[parentId].children)) {
                        window.candidateRunningMateMap[parentId].children = [];
                    }
                    return window.candidateRunningMateMap[parentId];
                }
                function findChildEntry(parentId, childId) {
                    const parent = normalizeParent(parentId);
                    childId = Number(childId);
                    return parent.children.find(c => Number(c.id) === childId) || null;
                }
                window.setRunningMateEV = function(parentId, childId, ev) {
                    parentId = Number(parentId);
                    childId = Number(childId);
                    ev = Number(ev) || 0;
                    const parent = normalizeParent(parentId);
                    let child = findChildEntry(parentId, childId);
                    if (!child) {
                        child = { id: childId, alwaysShow: false, ev: 0, name: `Candidate ${childId}`, color_hex: "#888888" };
                        parent.children.push(child);
                    }
                    child.ev = ev;
                    if (window.forcePatchFinalTable) window.forcePatchFinalTable();
                };
                window.addRunningMate = function(parentId, childId, ev = 0, alwaysShow = false, name = null, color_hex = null) {
                    parentId = Number(parentId);
                    childId = Number(childId);
                    ev = Number(ev) || 0;
                    const parent = normalizeParent(parentId);
                    let child = findChildEntry(parentId, childId);
                    if (child) {
                        child.ev = ev;
                        child.alwaysShow = !!alwaysShow;
                        if (name != null) child.name = name;
                        if (color_hex != null) child.color_hex = color_hex;
                    } else {
                        parent.children.push({
                            id: childId,
                            alwaysShow: !!alwaysShow,
                            ev,
                            name: name || `Candidate ${childId}`,
                            color_hex: color_hex || "#888888"
                        });
                    }
                    if (window.forcePatchFinalTable) window.forcePatchFinalTable();
                };
                window.removeRunningMate = function(parentId, childId) {
                    const parent = normalizeParent(parentId);
                    childId = Number(childId);
                    parent.children = parent.children.filter(c => Number(c.id) !== childId);
                    if (window.forcePatchFinalTable) window.forcePatchFinalTable();
                };
                function getCandidateMeta(candidateId) {
                    if (!window.e || !Array.isArray(e.candidate_json)) return null;
                    const idx = e.candidate_json.findIndex(c => c.pk == candidateId);
                    return idx >= 0 ? e.candidate_json[idx].fields : null;
                }
                function getDisplayMeta(candidateId, childEntry = null) {
                    const real = getCandidateMeta(candidateId);
                    if (real) {
                        return {
                            name: `${real.first_name} ${real.last_name}`,
                            color_hex: real.color_hex || "#000"
                        };
                    }
                    return {
                        name: childEntry?.name || `Candidate ${candidateId}`,
                        color_hex: childEntry?.color_hex || "#888888"
                    };
                }
                function getResultRow(candidateId) {
                    if (!window.e || !Array.isArray(e.final_overall_results)) return null;
                    return e.final_overall_results.find(r => r.candidate == candidateId);
                }
                function ensureParentRow(candidateId, templateId = null) {
                    let row = getResultRow(candidateId);
                    if (row) return row;
                    const template =
                        (templateId != null && getResultRow(templateId)) ||
                        (Array.isArray(e.final_overall_results) && e.final_overall_results[0]) ||
                        { electoral_votes: 0, popular_votes: 0 };
                    row = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(template));
                    row.candidate = Number(candidateId);
                    row.electoral_votes = Number(row.electoral_votes) || 0;
                    row.popular_votes = Number(row.popular_votes) || 0;
                    e.final_overall_results.push(row);
                    return row;
                }
                function sortParentIds(parentIds) {
                    parentIds.sort((a, b) => {
                        const rowA = getResultRow(a) || { electoral_votes: 0, popular_votes: 0 };
                        const rowB = getResultRow(b) || { electoral_votes: 0, popular_votes: 0 };
                        const evDiff = (Number(rowB.electoral_votes) || 0) - (Number(rowA.electoral_votes) || 0);
                        if (evDiff) return evDiff;
                        return (Number(rowB.popular_votes) || 0) - (Number(rowA.popular_votes) || 0);
                    });
                }
                function childShouldShow(child) {
                    const ev = getChildDisplayEV(child);
                    return !!child.alwaysShow || ev > 0;
                }
                function num(x) {
                    return Number(x) || 0;
                }
                window.getBaseCandidateEV = function(candidateId)  {
                    const row = e.final_overall_results.find(r => r.candidate === candidateId);
                    return row ? Number(row.electoral_votes) || 0 : 0;
                }
                function didCandidateWinState(statePK, candidateId) {
                    if (!window.e || !Array.isArray(e.final_state_results)) return false;
                    const stateEntry = e.final_state_results.find(s => s.state == statePK);
                    if (!stateEntry || !Array.isArray(stateEntry.result)) return false;
                    let winner = null;
                    let maxVotes = -Infinity;
                    for (const r of stateEntry.result) {
                        const votes =
                            r.popular_votes ??
                            r.votes ??
                            r.vote_count ??
                            r.raw_votes ??
                            0;
                        if (votes > maxVotes) {
                            maxVotes = votes;
                            winner = r.candidate;
                        }
                    }
                    return winner == candidateId;
                }
                function getDisplayEVs() {
                    const base200 = getBaseCandidateEV(200);
                    const base201 = getBaseCandidateEV(201);
                    const route200ToClinton = !!window.route200BaseToClinton;
                    return {
                        parents: {
                            200: Math.max(0, num(jeffersonEVs) + base200),
                            201: Math.max(0, num(adamsEVs) + base201)
                        },
                        children: {
                            1004: Math.max(0, num(burrEVs) + (route200ToClinton ? 0 : base200)),
                            1005: Math.max(0, num(clintonEVs) + (route200ToClinton ? base200 : 0)),
                            1006: Math.max(0, num(sAdamsEVs)),
                            1007: Math.max(0, num(monroeEVs)),
                            1008: Math.max(0, num(langdonEVs)),
                            1003: Math.max(0, num(pinckneyEVs) + base201 - jayEVs),
                            1009: Math.max(0, num(jayEVs))
                        }
                    };
                }
                window.getDisplayEVs = getDisplayEVs;
            	window.initializeCustomEVs = function() {
                    newYorkEVs   = 0;
                    jeffersonEVs = 0;
                    adamsEVs     = 0;
                    burrEVs      = 0;
                    clintonEVs   = 0;
                    sAdamsEVs    = 0;

                        langdonEVs += 3;
                    } else if (e.player_answers.includes(5400)) {
                        newYorkEVs = 5;
                        jeffersonEVs -= 1;
                        burrEVs += 1;
                        langdonEVs += 1;
                    } else if (e.player_answers.includes(5404)) {
                        newYorkEVs = 2;
                        jeffersonEVs -= 1;
                        burrEVs += 1;
                        clintonEVs -= 1;
                    }
                    if (burr_grievance >= 2) {
                        jeffersonEVs -= newYorkEVs;
                        burrEVs += newYorkEVs;
                        monroeEVs += newYorkEVs;

                        jayEVs = 1;
                    }
                    if (didCandidateWinState(1015, 200) && e.player_answers.includes(5471)) {
                        burrEVs -= 11;
                        sAdamsEVs = 11;
                    }
                };
                window.getEndingEVs = function () {
                    const evs = getDisplayEVs();
                    return {
                        J:   Number(evs.parents[200]) || 0,    // Jefferson
                        A:   Number(evs.parents[201]) || 0,    // Adams
                        B:   Number(evs.children[1004]) || 0,  // Burr
                        C:   Number(evs.children[1005]) || 0,  // Clinton
                        SA:  Number(evs.children[1006]) || 0,  // Samuel Adams
                        M:   Number(evs.children[1007]) || 0,  // Monroe
                        L:   Number(evs.children[1008]) || 0,  // Langdon
                        P:   Number(evs.children[1003]) || 0,  // Pinckney
                        Jay: Number(evs.children[1009]) || 0   // Jay
                    };
                };
                function getParentDisplayEV(parentId) {
                    const evs = getDisplayEVs();
                    if (parentId in evs.parents) return num(evs.parents[parentId]);
                    const row = getResultRow(parentId);
                    return row ? num(row.electoral_votes) : 0;
                }
                function getChildDisplayEV(child) {
                    const childId = num(child.id);
                    const evs = getDisplayEVs();
                    if (childId in evs.children) return num(evs.children[childId]);
                    return num(child.ev);
                }
                function buildRowsHtml() {
                    if (!window.e || !Array.isArray(e.final_overall_results)) return "";
                    let totalPopularVotes = e.final_overall_results.reduce(
                        (sum, row) => sum + (Number(row.popular_votes) || 0),
                        0
                    );
                    if (totalPopularVotes <= 0) totalPopularVotes = 1;
                    const map = window.candidateRunningMateMap || {};
                    const parentIds = Object.keys(map).map(Number);
                    for (const parentId of parentIds) {
                        ensureParentRow(parentId);
                    }
                    sortParentIds(parentIds);
                    let html = "";
                    for (const parentId of parentIds) {
                        const parentMeta = getCandidateMeta(parentId);
                        if (!parentMeta) continue;
                        const parentRow = ensureParentRow(parentId);
                        const parentName = `${parentMeta.first_name} ${parentMeta.last_name}`;
                        const parentColor = parentMeta.color_hex || "#000";
                        const parentEV = getParentDisplayEV(parentId);
                        const parentPV = Number(parentRow.popular_votes) || 0;
                        const parentPct = ((parentPV / totalPopularVotes) * 100).toFixed(1);
                        const visibleChildren = normalizeParent(parentId).children.filter(childShouldShow);
                        const rowspan = visibleChildren.length + 1;
                        html += `
                            <tr>
                                <td style="text-align:left; vertical-align:top;">
                                    <div>
                                        <span style="background-color:${parentColor}; color:${parentColor};">----</span>
                                        ${parentName}
                                    </div>
                                </td>
                                <td>${parentEV}</td>
                                <td rowspan="${rowspan}" style="vertical-align:middle;">${parentPV.toLocaleString()}</td>
                                <td rowspan="${rowspan}" style="vertical-align:middle;">${parentPct}%</td>
                            </tr>
                        `;
                        for (const child of visibleChildren) {
                            const childId = Number(child.id);
                            const childDisplay = getDisplayMeta(childId, child);
                            const childEV = getChildDisplayEV(child);
                            html += `
                                <tr>
                                    <td style="text-align:left; padding-left:20px; vertical-align:top;">
                                        <div>
                                            <span style="background-color:${childDisplay.color_hex}; color:${childDisplay.color_hex};">----</span>
                                            ${childDisplay.name}
                                        </div>
                                    </td>
                                    <td>${childEV}</td>
                                </tr>
                            `;
                        }
                    }
                    return html;
                }
                function patchFinalTable() {
                    if (!window.e || !Array.isArray(e.final_overall_results) || !Array.isArray(e.candidate_json)) {
                        return;
                    }
                    const table = document.querySelector(".final_results_table");
                    if (!table) return;
                    const ths = table.querySelectorAll("th");
                    const evHeader = ths[1] ? ths[1].textContent : "Electoral Votes";
                    const rowsHtml = buildRowsHtml();
                    if (table.dataset.ctHierarchySig === rowsHtml) return;
                    table.dataset.ctHierarchySig = rowsHtml;
                    table.innerHTML = `
                        <tbody>
                            <tr>
                                <th>Candidate</th>
                                <th>${evHeader}</th>
                                <th>Popular Votes</th>
                                <th>Popular Vote %</th>
                            </tr>
                            ${rowsHtml}
                        </tbody>
                    `;
                }
                window.forcePatchFinalTable = patchFinalTable;
                window.__finalTableHierarchyWatcher = setInterval(() => {
                    try {
                        patchFinalTable();
                    } catch (err) {
                        console.error("final table hierarchy patch failed:", err);
                    }
                }, 1);
                window.stopFinalTableWatcher = () => {
                    clearInterval(window.__finalTableHierarchyWatcher);
                    delete window.__finalTableHierarchyWatcher;
                    delete window.__finalTableHierarchyInstalled;
                };
                console.log("Final table hierarchy watcher installed.");
            })();

            }

            function shuffleArray(array) {
              for (let i = array.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
                const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
                [array[i], array[j]] = [array[j], array[i]];
              }
              return array;
            }
